compos.summarization:
This smartphone UI screen is a feedback interface for an app. The main contents and functions include:

1. **Title**: "Feedback" - indicating the purpose of the screen.
2. **Instructional Text**: "We value your feedback. Please select from one of the following options." - guiding the user on what to do.
3. **Two Main Buttons**:
   - "Report an issue with the app" - for users to report any problems or bugs they encounter.
   - "Submit an idea for the app" - for users to suggest new features or improvements.

The screen is designed to collect user feedback efficiently by providing clear options for reporting issues or submitting ideas.
